description: How much can be bought or sold near the current price. Returns USD depth on each side within 0.1% to 2% of the price for a market, plus the expected slippage for a market order of a given size over time.

coin.description: Market name, any case: "BTC", "eth", "HYPE", "kPEPE", or a HIP-3 market such as "xyz:TSLA".

orderSizeUsd.description: Order size for the slippage estimate, in USD (default 100,000).

name: hydromancer_market_depth
title: Order book depth and slippage
